time is up.Let's start from the salutation.We know compared with dear sir or madam,Hi buddy is too informal and not serious.In the first part, the purpose is not clearly statedand the language with my heart broken is not appropriate.In part two, the information is neither detailed nor logical.The language unbelievable is too subjective, not factual.In part three, apparently the appeal is not reasonable and practical.In the signature part, the tone is not serious and businesslike.Therefore, here is a table for the tips on how to write a letter of complaint.According to the table, the purpose and the problem should be clearly and directly stated.The detailed information should be factual and logically organized.The appeal and expectation should be reasonable and practical.That's for the content.The language should be formal and appropriate,and the tone should be serious and businesslike.By the way, do you still remember that we have learned how to write a formal emailto make inquiries in Unit 3 Book 2?Some items are quite similar.The left column is for formal letters, while the right column is for informal ones.In formal letters, dear sir or madam, dear manager are used instead of given names like James, dear James.Full forms are used instead of contracted forms.Passive voice is used more than active voice.Longer, more complex sentences more than shorter, simpler sentences.Formal language I would like to rather than colloquial or oral language I'm gonna.And finally, yours faithfully plus full name instead of yours poorly or speak soon plus first name.Okay, as I said, life is not always smooth.Bad things happen.We can't avoid buying some low-quality goods or being provided with poor services.That's why we need to learn how to write a formal letter of complaint.Here happens something annoying.Please turn to page 52 and find this paragraph.Please read the paragraph and answer the following three questions.You will have the next minute for that.Have you found the answers?Number one, I think we are going to complain about both the product and the service.Number two, the specific problems are two missing buttons.The right button is missing.The left button is missing.The specific problems are two missing buttons, the wrong size and terrible customer service.Number three, if I'm supposed to select one or two options, I think number four is a must.And between number two and number three, either is okay.So let's select number two and number four, refund my money and make some improvement to customer service.Okay?Now let's practice our writing in our interaction section.Imitate the sample letter and write a formal letter of complaint to the online closed store.You may start your letter of complaint like this.You may state your desired solutions like this.You may end your letter of complaint like this.They are all listed on your worksheet.After you have finished your writing, please check your compositions in pairs according to this checklist on your worksheet.Is the complaint stated clearly and directly?Is the information factual and relevant?Is the appeal reasonable and practical?Is the language appropriate and formal?Is the tone serious and businesslike?This checklist will be used for your assignment.After class, please check your own composition according to this checklist for editing on your worksheet.Before you do your interaction part, here's the assignment for today.Polish your writing based on the peer's review and the checklist for editing.That's all for today.In the next period, we will start our cultural focus.See you next time.
